en.description:
With a space of 270m2, a capacity of nearly 200 guests, full sound, light and modern and luxurious facilities. Conference room at TND Hotel will be the most ideal choice for events and seminars in the coastal city of Nha Trang.

Besides, This is also the place to hold birthday parties, party ... with cozy seats, beautifully decorated. People gather together to create a feeling of happiness and cohesion between family members.
